findings.text: the dry-run scope check now resolves the base with _resolve_commit(repo_root, base), the same expression the launch uses at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1916, so the dry run reaches the launch's verdict on a stacked dispatch; the check runs only under report_live_conflicts, which is pre-existing, so a dry run without that flag still does not judge at all.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the node goal is to admit a dispatch cut from a stopped holder's chain tip onto that holder's claimed paths; the gained commits make the two paths that still judged a call without the dispatch base pass it, at reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:1148 (_resolve_commit(repo_root, base), the same expression the launch uses at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1916) and reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:1799 (widening_base read from the widening run's own pointer), so the dry run and the widening check now reach the launch's verdict.
VERDICT done_when: the node done-when names the fixture gate (admit on the holder's chain tip, refuse on main, both pointers record the stacking, the scopes row binds, promotion names the descendant) plus the test module and every module importing the changed functions; for the gained commits the manifest records round3-head-arm.log at 7adecfbdc ('21 passed', EXIT=0) over tests/test_a_stacked_run_may_write_its_holders_paths.py and tests/test_crew_dispatch_guard.py, round3-base-arm.log at 2539356 ('1 failed, 4 passed', EXIT=1), and one negative control per new case (round3-nc1.log, round3-nc2.log, both '1 failed', EXIT=1); the wider suite delta the same done-when implies is unmeasured and the manifest says so under follow_ons.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest's orientation_write_paths lists eight paths (reckon/crew/node.py, dispatch.py, dispatch_claims.py, runs.py, promotion.py, tests/test_a_stacked_run_may_write_its_holders_paths.py, the landing fragment and the figures directory); the four paths the gained diff touches are the fragment, reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py and the test module, all inside that list, plus reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py, which the original FENCE SCOPE omits but the round-3 resume advice grants by name, so every path is inside the scope the run was working under.
VERDICT manifest: read at the reviewed head 50b4d1b05 - status complete, changed_paths names the landed files, tests: is a literal pytest command and negative_control_log is the bare path; baseline_suite and after_suite are now flat JSON records carrying revision, command, exit_status, log_path, completed, failure_count and failure_ids, answering the prior review's prose finding, but both `command` values carry angle-bracket placeholders.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against 96f902caa - 7adecfbdc adds eight production lines (the dry run's base_revision at reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:1148 and widening_base at reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:1799) plus 101 lines of two new cases, and 50b4d1b05 adds 68 lines to the landing fragment; four files changed, +186/-0, all additive.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/claims.py:99 (widen_claim calls refuse_widen_scope_conflicts with the run's own pointer, which carries base_sha written at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2272), reckon/crew/dispatch.py:935 and :991 (the paired dry run's plan_dispatch), reckon/crew/dispatch.py:805 (shadow dry run), reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1329 and :1505, reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1708, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2641, reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1787
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:1148 passes _resolve_commit(repo_root, base) into the dry run's check and reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:1799 reads the widening run's own base_sha, so both paths now agree with the launch on a stacked dispatch.
SCORE evidence: 16
JUSTIFICATION evidence: round3-head-arm.log names its revision, tree and command and ends EXIT=0 (21 passed) and round3-base-arm.log ends EXIT=1 (1 failed, 4 passed), but round3-nc1.log and round3-nc2.log carry no header naming a revision, and the wider suite delta the done-when implies is unmeasured.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in git diff 96f902caa..50b4d1b05 is inside the scope granted in the third resume advice (reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py and tests/test_crew_dispatch_guard.py both granted by name), and the diff is +186/-0 with no unrelated edit.
SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_stacked_run_may_write_its_holders_paths.py:380 fails on 'assert refused == admitted' when the dry run's base_revision is removed (round3-nc1.log) and :431 raises ScopeConflict when the widening base is removed (round3-nc2.log), so each assertion reddens on reinstating the defect.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: the new import at reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:76 follows the idiom already used at reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:30, and the added comments name the mechanism rather than a plan, ticket or version label.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:1148 reuses _resolve_commit from reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py (re-exported at reckon/crew/recovery.py:267) and reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:1805 reaches the existing _raise_repository_scope_conflict parameter rather than adding a second judge; the search over reckon/crew found no other owner of either capability.
FINDING /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261022T100057429591-a-stacked-run-may-write-its-holders-paths/manifest.md:21 follow-on: baseline_suite's `command` (and after_suite's at :22) carries the angle-bracket placeholders <base-revision-copy>, <worktree> and <scratch>, which the record spec forbids ('absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder'); a placeholder command cannot be re-run, so promotion's suite-delta check cannot re-run either arm from the record - the literal text survives only in the cited log's own '# command:' header line.
FINDING /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261022T100057429591-a-stacked-run-may-write-its-holders-paths/manifest.md:7 follow-on: the checkpoint says 'baseline_suite records that arm as incomplete rather than as a result', while baseline_suite reads completed: true, exit_status 1 over the one-module base arm at 2539356; the two disagree about what the field holds, so a reader cannot tell which arm the record claims.
FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/a-coordinator-can-clear-its-own-duties/a-stacked-run-may-write-its-holders-paths.html:270 follow-on: the two control rows assert the revision '7adecfbdc minus that line' and '7adecfbdc minus that kwarg', but round3-nc1.log and round3-nc2.log each begin with the pytest progress line and carry no header naming a revision, tree or command, so the revision those rows cite is not recorded by the log they point at.
